env BOLERO_MODULE=on

# Download modules to avoid stderr chatter
bolero mod download example.com@v1.0.0
bolero mod download example.com/newcycle/a@v1.0.0
bolero mod download example.com/newcycle/a@v1.0.1
bolero mod download example.com/newcycle/b@v1.0.0

bolero mod init -modfile=go.mod m
! bolero get example.com/newcycle/a@v1.0.0
cmp stderr stderr-expected

-- stderr-expected --
bolero: example.com/newcycle/a@v1.0.0 indirectly requires example.com/newcycle/a@v1.0.1, not example.com/newcycle/a@v1.0.0
